methodology: Identity-only universe expand batch 4. New manufacturers: boz-digital, black-rooster-audio, kit-plugins, crave-dsp, zplane, plogue, decomposer, image-line, presonus, mastering-the-mix, waldorf, gforce-software, krotos. Fills: accentize full KVR line; steinberg DAW hub_app + discrete plugs/libraries; plugin-alliance BEATSURFING from products.json; curated UVI FX/host gaps. Skipped dense: fabfilter, softube, soundtoys, eventide (Newfangled already), melda, voxengo, auburn, baby-audio, cableguys, chowdsp, kilohearts already, puremix empty, produce-like-a-pro, ableton stock. No invented Studio One / Ableton / Bitwig stock-device rows. Cross-mfr normalized-name dedup. No invented versions.
